title: Community-Hub
tagline: Community-Hub is a platform through which users from DAO can interact with each other without sharing their identity instead the users can connect through the ENS domain and can have video-chat as well group chatting through them as well.
description:
So, community hub is an easy-to-use video chat platform through which users can interact with other folks easily without relying on centralized servers for sharing their sensitive information instead of that we will be using huddle01 decentralized servers which are secured and p2p network through which our sensitive information remain safe, and instead of remembering long public keys, we can easily chat though ENS id with just one click. 

Eg. If I want to connect with other users I have to remember their public keys to send invites with the help of the community hub we will make this process seamless, with just a click with the help of the ENS domain and huddle01 SDK.

Suppose I want to have a conversion with Vitalik, I can just send an invite though with huddle01 sdk through Vitalik.eth address with my .eth address instead of long public keys.
how_its_made:
So, for making community-hub we have used technologies like :

frontend: NextJS, Typescript

Platform: Huddle01, ENS, create NextApp
